title: Immunohistochemical Staining of Paraffin-Embedded Tissue Sections for GPNMB, TFE3, PD-L1, CD3, MYC, and Ki67
author: Franz Zemp

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Rehydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize sections in xylene (3 × 5 min), then rehydrate through graded ethanol: 100 % ethanol (2 × 3 min), 95 % ethanol (3 min), 70 % ethanol (3 min), and finally distilled water (2 min).

steps.title: Heat‑Induced Epitope Retrieval
steps.instruction: Place slides in 1× antigen retrieval buffer (10 mM citrate, pH 6.0) and perform retrieval in a pressure cooker for 22 min at full pressure; cool in the buffer for 20–30 min to room temperature, then rinse in distilled water followed by 1× TBST.

steps.title: Block Endogenous Peroxidase
steps.instruction: Apply one drop of Peroxidase‑Blocking Solution (Dako, S202386‑2) to each section, incubate 15 min at room temperature in a humidified chamber, then rinse thoroughly with 1× TBS.

steps.title: Block Non‑Specific Binding
steps.instruction: Apply 200 µL Protein Block (Agilent, X090930‑2) to each section, incubate 30 min at room temperature, then gently tap off excess without rinsing.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute the appropriate primary antibody in Antibody Diluent (or 1× TBS + 1 % BSA) at the following ratios: GPNMB (AF2550) 1:250, GPNMB (E4D7P) 1:500, TFE3 (MRQ‑37) 1:100, PD‑L1 (E1L3N) 1:200, CD3 (SP7) 1:100, MYC (71D10) 1:200, Ki67 (D3B5) 1:500. Apply 100–200 µL to each section, incubate 1 h at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C in a humidified chamber, then wash 3 × in 1× TBST (5 min each).

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply one drop of the appropriate species‑specific polymer‑HRP secondary antibody (Vector Laboratories or DAKO EnVision) to each section, incubate 30 min at room temperature, then wash 3 × in 1× TBST (5 min each).

steps.title: Chromogenic DAB Development
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh DAB working solution by mixing one drop of DAB concentrate with 1 mL DAB substrate solution; apply to each section and incubate until brown color appears (typically 1–5 min, monitor microscopically), then stop the reaction by rinsing in distilled water.

steps.title: Counterstain, Dehydrate, and Clear
steps.instruction: Counterstain with hematoxylin for 1–5 min, rinse in running tap water or bluing reagent, dehydrate through graded ethanol (70 %, 95 %, 100 %; 2 × 2 min each), and clear in xylene (2 × 3 min).

steps.title: Mount Slides
steps.instruction: Mount sections with Cytoseal XYL mounting medium, place coverslips, and allow slides to dry completely.

steps.title: Scan Slides
steps.instruction: Scan stained slides on an Aperio Scanscope® XT slide scanner at 20× or 40× magnification.

steps.title: Analyze Images
steps.instruction: Analyze digitized images using ImageScope software (v12.2.2.5015) or QuPath (v0.5.0) to quantify staining intensity, percentage of positive cells, and localization.
